notes.title: TUTORIAL LEVEL ADDED
notes.notes:
Now you can practice cleaning in a safe place with your friends.
The training room contains all types of tools and some types of abomination.
Destroy them and fill in the progress bar on the monitor. Then burn the artifact in the furnace to complete the level.
